name: Replication data for: Of Nickell bias and its cures: Comment on Gaibulloev, Sandler and Sul
description: A comment on Gaibulloev, Sandler and Gul arguing that their suggestion of solving the Nickell bias proglem for null hypothesis testing is misguided and that the issue is a third order issue.
citation: Beck, Nathaniel; Katz, Jonathan N.; Mignozzetti, Umberto, 2014, "Replication data for: Of Nickell bias and its cures: Comment on Gaibulloev, Sandler and Sul", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/24503, Harvard Dataverse, V4
